quest.title: A Message From the Junior
quest.description: Mika seems to be looking for you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Surveyor's Breakfast Sandwich x5, Guide to Ballad x3

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight! We're so lucky to have you come and test out the entertainment stalls. It really puts my mind at ease!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This is actually my first time taking part in a development project, so I'm a little nervous. It's kinda frying my brain...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: All I had to do was put a casing on an existing device. But there were so many design considerations, so many parameters to adjust...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I don't envy Captain Albedo, having to create purpose-built devices from scratch... It must be such a difficult task.

choices.text: I think it's functioning really well.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Wow, uh... Th—Thank you! Thanks, Honorary Knight, that means a lot coming from you!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I'll... I'll keep doing my best. Hopefully, I'll get to the point where I can build some useful stuff for the Reconnaissance Company...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Oh, I won a few toys in one of the games. I'd like you to have this one...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I have another one the same. Now, whenever I look at it, I'll think of all the encouragement you gave me!

choices.text: Don't be hard on yourself. You can only get better.
